title: The Big Bang
summary: A draft chapter about the Big Bang model, evidence, early-universe timeline, misconceptions, and open questions.
body:
## Introduction

Write your introduction here in your own words.

## What is the Big Bang model?

Explain what the model describes and define important terms.

## Evidence for the model

Research cosmic expansion, the cosmic microwave background, and the abundance of light elements.

## Timeline of the early universe

Build a timeline using reliable sources and check all dates.

## Common misconceptions

Explain how expansion of space differs from an ordinary explosion.

## What remains unknown?

Separate established evidence from open questions and speculation.

## Summary

Write three to five key takeaways.
references: Add only sources you have actually read. Include the author or organization, title, date, and link.
